title: NDR Alert Outbound Payload — Engineer 3 → Engineer 4
description: ECS-compliant alert payload emitted by the Data Lake to the Kinetic Layer. Every document written to ndr-correlated-* BEFORE dispatch. Pre-Commit Pattern enforced.

@timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC. The moment the correlation was materialized in the Data Lake.

version.description: ECS version — PINNED. Rejection if absent or mismatched.

eng3_correlation_id.description: SHA-256(source.ip + @timestamp + sigma_rule_id). Unique, deterministic, idempotent. This is the audit trail anchor — immutable once written.

host_ip.description: ECS: host.ip. The primary internal asset IP under investigation.

host_id.description: ECS: host.id. Stable asset identifier from CMDB/inventory. Used by Eng4 for SG targeting.

alert_type.description: Detection category — mapped from firing Sigma rule ID. Drives Eng4 playbook selection.

severity.description: Tiered from event.risk_score: CRITICAL>=90, HIGH>=70, MEDIUM>=40, LOW<40.

aws_security_group_id.description: AWS Security Group ID. Sourced from CloudTrail enrichment. Eng4 uses this to execute ISOLATE action.

iam_user.description: ECS: user.name. AWS IAM ARN or username of the implicated identity. Eng4 uses this for IAM quarantine.

pre_commit_written.description: MUST be true. Alert cannot be dispatched unless Data Lake write is confirmed.
